thisIsAPreviewNoTasksHaveBeenImported: This is a preview; no tasks have been imported. Matching IDs are not duplicated. Previously imported tasks with changes are not overwritten.
prepareTheAffectedPeriodsFirstThenReturn: Prepare the affected periods first, then return and preview the import again.
theFileChangedPreviewItAgain: The file changed. Preview it again.
importSourceFilesAreAvailableToWorkspace: Import source files are available to workspace owners and administrators.
sourceFileAndMappingAreHiddenUntilAccess: Source file and mapping are hidden until access is confirmed. Drafts are preserved on this page.
oneProjectUpTo50TaskRows100Columns: One project, up to 50 task rows, 100 columns, and 1 MiB of UTF-8. Files are not truncated. Imports ordinary tasks and five existing custom-field types; this is a limited Asana import.
chooseAFileAndIdSource: Choose a file and ID source
useTheSameIdentifierWhenUploadingThisPro: Use the same identifier when uploading this project again. It links external string IDs to previously imported tasks.
stagingPreservesTheSourceFileForMappingI: Staging preserves the source file for mapping; it does not create tasks. URLs, attachments, and links are not downloaded. JSON and other encodings are not supported yet.
chooseRequiredColumnsAStatusAndTheNecess: Choose required columns, a status, and the necessary delimiters and units. Up to 20 custom fields and 100 reference mappings are supported.
refreshSourcesAndKeepMySelections: Refresh sources and keep my selections
checkingAllRowsAndCurrentReferences: Checking all rows and current references…
allRowsAreImportedTogetherConflictsPriva: All rows are imported together. Conflicts, private entries, and unconfirmed columns block the import.
theOriginalMappingAndOperationKeyStayLoc: The original mapping and operation key stay locked until the request is resolved.
valueTooLongEditTheFile: {{preview}}… · value too long; edit the file
chooseColumnsByPositionExternalIdsStaySt: Choose columns by position. External IDs stay strings, preserving leading zeros and large numbers. Missing IDs are not replaced with titles or row numbers. Imported subtasks have separate unknown estimates; linking a parent does not merge budgets.
doNotImportIntoThisField: Do not import into this field
alsoIncludeTheAssigneeAsAParticipantFoll: Also include the assignee as a participant. Followers and participants do not become assignees automatically.
mapEachNonemptySourceValueToAnExistingEn: Map each nonempty source value to an existing entry. Display names are not matched automatically. To stop importing a column, explicitly preserve its source data below.
supportsTextNumberDurationDateAndCheckbo: Supports text, number, duration, date, and checkbox fields. Field definitions are not created or changed. Asana hours are a current snapshot; they do not create original estimates, weekly plans, or time entries.
doNotWriteToACustomField: Do not write to a custom field
thisColumnIsAlreadyUsedByACoreField: This column is already used by a core field. Remove that mapping before using it for a custom field.
hoursConvertToWholeMinutesWithoutRoundin: Hours convert to whole minutes without rounding.
theNumberIsStoredInTheSelectedUnitsRecon: The number is stored in the selected units; reconciliation records those units.
dataStaysInTheSourceFileAndReconciliatio: Data stays in the source file and reconciliation. Confirming does not import dependencies, links, or history. Required dependencies block this pilot; exclude those tasks before uploading.
iConfirmTheseTasksCanBeShownToAll: I confirm these tasks can be shown to all members of this workspace.
unknownPrivacyIsNotTreatedAsPublicAccess: Unknown privacy is not treated as public access. Explicitly private entries remain blocked. Migrating private tasks and permissions is outside this import.
columnPositionsArePreservedIncludingDupl: Column positions are preserved, including duplicate headers. Row means a CSV record, not a physical line within a multiline cell. Text and links are not executed.
fileExceeds1MibImportsDoNotTruncateFiles: File exceeds 1 MiB. Imports do not truncate files; choose a smaller CSV.
fileIsEmptyChooseACsvWithHeadersAnd: File is empty. Choose a CSV with headers and tasks.
couldNotReadUtf8SaveTheFileAs: Could not read UTF-8. Save the file as UTF-8 without replacing unknown characters.
csvContainsAnInvalidNullCharacter: CSV contains an invalid null character.
useAValidFileNameOfUpTo255: Use a valid file name of up to 255 characters.
sourceRowsToCreateUnchangedConflictsBloc: Source rows: {{sourceRows}} · to create: {{createCount}} · unchanged: {{skipCount}} · conflicts: {{conflictCount}} · blocked: {{blockedCount}}. Source-only columns: {{preservedColumnCount}}.
noTasksImportedSourceRowsCreated0Skipped: No tasks imported. Source rows: {{sourceRows}}; created: 0, skipped: 0.
everyRowIsReconciledWithItsTargetTaskTas: {{appliedAt}}. Every row is reconciled with its target task. Task estimates remain unset; no weekly plans, actual-hour entries, or original estimates were created.
originalDataAndOperationKeyArePreserved2: {{action}} {{saveState}}. Original data and operation key are preserved.
thisColumnHasDistinctValuesTheFirst100Ar: This column has {{count}} distinct values. The first 100 are shown; this pilot supports at most 100 mappings in total. Narrow the file or preserve the column as source-only.
nonemptyRowsExampleTheFullValueIsAvailab: Nonempty rows: {{count}}. Example: {{example}}. The full value is available in the source table.

issues.missing_external_id: Choose a nonempty external task ID. IDs are preserved as strings.
issues.duplicate_external_id: The source contains a duplicate external task ID. Give each row a unique ID.
issues.unmapped_person: Map this source person to an existing workspace member.
issues.unmapped_status: Map this source status to an existing project status.
issues.unmapped_section: Map this source section to an existing project section.
issues.unmapped_tag: Map this source tag to an existing workspace tag.
issues.unmapped_column: Map this column or explicitly preserve it as source-only.
issues.invalid_date: The date is invalid for the selected format. Correct the source date or mapping.
issues.invalid_value: This value cannot be imported into the selected field. Check its type, units, and empty-cell handling.
issues.invalid_field: The selected custom field is unavailable, locked, or incompatible. Refresh the available fields.
issues.parent_missing: The parent task cannot be resolved. Include its source row or use an existing imported parent.
issues.parent_cycle: These parent relationships form a cycle. Correct the source relationships.
issues.target_changed: A previously imported target changed. It will not be overwritten; review the target task.
issues.source_changed: Source data or mapping changed. Refresh and preview the import again.
issues.private_source: This source row is explicitly private and cannot be imported into this workspace-visible pilot.
issues.scope_unconfirmed: Confirm that the selected tasks may be shown to all workspace members.
issues.unsupported_relationship: The source requires a relationship that this import does not support. Remove it or exclude the affected task.
issues.unknown: This import issue needs attention. Check the affected row and column, then refresh the preview.
